admission.justification: The help in cli/dashboard.py must name the causes serving/daemon.py acts on, and a test fails when the source-digest cause is missing; without it a user cannot tell why an equal-version daemon was restarted.

conditions: The help lists every cause that makes ensure() restart a running daemon: version, Python source digest, host and port.
exclusions: The restart behaviour itself, which the dashboard-replacement invariant states.
